name: Install AnythingLLM via Docker Compose
description:
The user requested technical documentation and a docker-compose file for installing Mintplex Labs' AnythingLLM using Docker, referencing the provided official URL. 
Relevant instructions were identified to pull the latest image, establish local storage via volume mounts to prevent data loss, and configure environment variables like UID/GID.
Key details include accessing the interface on port 3001, managing Linux/Mac vs Windows paths, and resolving common networking issues for Ollama connections.
This information provides the necessary components to construct an installation guide that ensures persistent storage and correct container permissions. 
The discussion centers on translating official source content into a structured configuration file and user instructions.
